description: At least three HTTP 500+ events were observed for asset-service within five minutes.
recommendedAction: Check service logs, dependency health, database connectivity, resource utilisation, and recent deployments. Restore service only after identifying the cause.

description: At least three HTTP 401/403 events were observed for user test-user within ten minutes.
recommendedAction: Review the user's recent activity, validate assigned roles and permissions, and investigate unexpected access attempts before changing privileges.

description: At least five failed-login events were observed from source IP 192.0.2.55 within five minutes.
recommendedAction: Review authentication logs, apply rate limiting, consider temporary IP restrictions, and verify whether affected accounts require password resets.
